name: Transparent Proxy
description: Bundled producer (docs/DESIGN-traffic-attribution.md §2.1): capture HTTP/S from tools that don't honour HTTP_PROXY, without configuring each one. Sets up an OS-level redirect (iptables on Linux, pf on macOS) of this host's outbound 80/443 into mitmproxy's transparent mode, running RedLog's existing mitmproxy addon — so captured request/response events are identical to the regular-proxy path, just reached transparently. Invasive and privileged (rewrites nat rules, needs root); runs out-of-process with an explicit teardown. Disable/remove it if you don't want transparent interception.
author: RedLog

capture.name: mitmproxy transparent → scanner.http
capture.description: Redirect local 80/443 into mitmproxy transparent mode + RedLog's addon, capturing tools that ignore proxy env vars. Requires root; always tear down when done.
